items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: She played the style, if you played what they call in those days was ragtime which was Scott Joplin style.

ctx.x: Your mother you said went to study music. Oh yes, she was a graduate of Cincinnati Conservatory.

I see. She played the style, if you played what they call in those days was ragtime which was Scott Joplin style. She played Dill Pickle and Maple Leaf Rag and all those things. She had all the music to it. I've got the original music on Missouri Waltz and all those kind of things.
Oh yeah. What about St. Louis? Did you go up to St. Louis to see your brother there?
